## Où j'en suis

SAML ACS verification for Fernhill is implemented on branch `daniel/saml-acs` using signxml, after python3-saml could not build on the Alpine base image. Signature and condition checks, replay protection and a 120 s clock skew are in place, and the auth tests pass. PR #412 is merged.

- [en-cours] Loading Fernhill's staging IdP metadata and sending them our staging SP metadata
- [prochaine-étape] Send Fernhill staging SP metadata by Wednesday EOD, for the Thursday 10:00 New York demo
- [prochaine-étape] Create a separate ticket to enforce SSO and disable password login for Fernhill users
- [essai-raté] python3-saml on the Alpine base: xmlsec and lxml libxml2 versions clash, and a source build of lxml did not fix it
- [décision] Use signxml, drop python3-saml and xmlsec, and write the SAML condition checks ourselves (source: t08)
- [décision] Clock skew is 120 s, per the Fernhill contract annex (source: t12)
